title: Factory transaction tables of 19 shifted framework AIDL interfaces (CodeLinaro LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900 and PICO)

explained_differences.Landroid/telecom/Call$Details;: capabilitiesToString(I): the ported CodeLinaro CAPABILITY_ADD_PARTICIPANT (0x02000000) entry is identical; the factory additionally prints CAPABILITY_SUPPORTS_RTT_REMOTE (0x04000000), a separate CodeLinaro RTT feature that is not part of the IConnectionService table and is not ported.

explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/ConnectivityService$: Anonymous class numbering: the factory has an extra CodeLinaro PhoneStateListener as ConnectivityService$1, so the NetdEventCallback with the PICO DNS batching is $5 in the factory and $4 in Source. onDnsEvent of Source $4 equals factory $5 instruction by instruction apart from register moves (see onDnsEvent evidence).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/ConnectivityService;: <init>: the ported PICO DNS-event fields (mLastDnsSuccessTimestamp, 5000 ms interval, 30-entry hostNameList/returnCodeList/timestampList) are initialised identically. Remaining differences are unported code of other features: PICO IExtConnectivityService (ExtImplFactory, setupUniqueDeviceName, init), CodeLinaro preferred-subscription PhoneStateListener, mRedirectUrl/mayNeedUpdateProxy/mNetworkState/mNonDefaultSubscriptionLingerDelayMs, anonymous class numbering, framework-res IDs. addDnsEventInfo/clearDnsEventInfo are identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/ActivityManagerSe: isActiveInstrumentation(I): identical except the synthetic accessor number (access$1900 in the factory, access$1800 in Source), which depends on unrelated members.

finishBooting(): the ported CodeLinaro change (no per-ABI installd markBootComplete / zygote loop) matches the factory. Remaining differences are PICO/Smartisan hooks (SysOptBridge UidCpuRunner.registerBackupModeReceiver, ISmartService.finishBooting, 'About to commit checkpoint' and DEBUG_PROCESSES logging) and mContext vs mInjector.getContext(); outside the AIDL tables.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/UserController$7;: sendResult(Bundle): identical except synthetic accessor numbering (access$N).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/UserController;: Pre-created user checks in startUser/finishUserUnlocked/finishUserUnlockedCompleted are identical. Remaining differences are PICO hooks without donor (IExtUserController.finishUserUnlocked/startPicoFactoryTestService, IBootEventStat boot events, elapsedRealtime/keyguard-secure logging) and framework-res animation IDs passed to startFreezingScreen.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/display/VirtualDispl: Constructor signature: Source takes (..., uniqueId, uniqueIndex, VirtualDisplayConfig) as Android 11; the factory adds (Context, int captureType) for the PICO capture-display subsystem (CaptureDisplayUtils/CaptureSurfaceAgent), which has no donor and is outside the IDisplayManager table. mDisplayIdToMirror and getDisplayIdToMirrorLocked are identical.

createVirtualDisplayLocked(..., VirtualDisplayConfig): name/uniqueId from VirtualDisplayConfig and the device construction are identical to the factory; the factory additionally computes a PICO capture type/token (CaptureDisplayUtils) and sets the Smartisan PeroptWhiteListParser skip-single-layer flag (0x100000), both PICO subsystems without donor outside this table.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/notification/Notific: silenceNotificationSound() and dump() differ only in synthetic accessor numbering (access$N); pullStats and the rest of the binder stub are identical.

dump(): not changed by this port (hasUndecoratedRemoteView is identical). Source android-10.0.0_r47 prints the small-icon resource name via idDebugString; CodeLinaro/factory print the Icon directly. Pre-existing AOSP r47 vs CodeLinaro difference.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/pm/PackageManagerSer: The ported CodeLinaro mBlockDeleteOnUserRemoveForTest/readPermissionStateForUser/userRemovedForTest members are identical. <init> differs by PICO/Smartisan code (IExtPackageManagerService, PackageManagerServiceMonitorEx/SmtBase, boot event stats, delLPwFile) and a lambda is only numbered differently (lambda$removeUnusedPackagesLPw$33).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/pm/UserManagerServic: areGuestUsersEphemeral(): only the framework-res ID of config_guestUserEphemeral differs (factory 0x1110088, Source 0x1110085); resource IDs of framework-res are not ported. All pre-created user members are identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/policy/PhoneWindowMa: interceptKeyBeforeQueueing: the ported volume-key silenceNotificationSound() block is identical. Remaining differences are PICO IExtPhoneWindowManager hooks (HCIT power-key test mode, back key in 2D reposition mode, factorytest log, key repeat count) without donor.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wm/ActivityStack;: removeTask/startActivityLocked: the ported TRANSIT_SHOW_SINGLE_TASK_DISPLAY and notifySingleTaskDisplayEmpty code is identical. Remaining differences are PICO debug logging compiled in (DEBUG_STACK/DEBUG_ADD_REMOVE/DEBUG_USER_LEAVING are not constants in the factory), PICO IExtActivityStartController.onTaskRemoved, and the CodeLinaro ActivityOptions.getAvoidMoveToFront check (separate feature).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wm/AppTransitionCont: handleAppTransitionReady: the ported notifySingleTaskDisplayDrawn scheduling is identical; the factory keeps DEBUG_APP_TRANSITIONS logging compiled in (PICO debug flags are not constants).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wm/DisplayContent;: removeImmediately/reparentDisplayContent/updateLocation/getLocationInParentDisplay/notifyLocationInParentDisplayChanged are identical apart from PICO IExtDisplayContent.removeImmediately and DEBUG_DISPLAY logging in removeImmediately; two gesture-exclusion lambdas only differ in D8 lambda numbering ($27/$28).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wm/TaskChangeNotific: <init>: the ported single-task-display consumers are identical; the factory additionally creates PICO IExtTaskChangeNotificationController via ExtImplFactory (no donor).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/wm/WindowState;: <init>/reportResized: the ported embedded-display members (mEmbeddedDisplayContents, mLastReportedDisplayOffset, updateLocationInParentDisplayIfNeeded, add/removeEmbeddedDisplayContent) are identical. Remaining differences are the CodeLinaro gesture-exclusion logging arrays (mLastRequestedExclusionHeight etc., separate feature), PICO IExtWindowState/IExtActivityStartController.onReportResized hooks and PICO debug logging compiled in.

explained_differences.Lcom/android/internal/telephony/uicc/Icc: Only mSmsCountOnIcc, EVENT_GET_SMS_RECORD_SIZE_DONE (28) and getSmsCapacityOnIcc() belong to ISms.getSmsCapacityOnIccForSubscriber; that case of handleMessage is identical (one D8 const reuse). The rest of <init>/handleMessage in the factory is the CodeLinaro essential-records/APP_DETECTED (event 101, mEssentialRecordsLoadedRegistrants, onDetected) refactor and a Source-only 'Record Load Exception' log, outside the AIDL tables; not ported.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/internal/telephony/uicc/Rui: fetchRuimRecords(): the ported EF_SMS record-size request is present in both; the factory splits the method into CodeLinaro fetchEssentialRuimRecords() (essential-records refactor, outside the AIDL tables, not ported), so the remaining record loads appear moved.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/internal/telephony/uicc/SIM: fetchSimRecords(): the ported EF_SMS record-size request is present in both; the factory moves IMSI/ICCID/MSISDN/SPN loading to CodeLinaro fetchEssentialSimRecords() (essential-records refactor, outside the AIDL tables, not ported).

explained_differences.Landroid/net/INetworkMonitor$Default;: The factory InProcessNetworkStack.apk is shrunk by R8 and drops the unused $Default class; Source NetworkStack.apk keeps it. INetworkMonitor and INetworkMonitor$Stub (transaction table and unmarshalling) are identical.
explained_differences.Landroid/net/INetworkMonitor$Stub$Proxy;: Removed from the factory InProcessNetworkStack.apk by R8 (the network stack never calls itself); the proxy used by system_server is in services.jar and is identical to the factory.
explained_differences.Landroid/net/INetworkMonitorCallbacks$De: Removed from the factory InProcessNetworkStack.apk by R8; Stub$Proxy (used by NetworkMonitor) is identical.
explained_differences.Landroid/net/ip/IIpClient$Default;: Removed from the factory InProcessNetworkStack.apk by R8; IIpClient$Stub is identical.
explained_differences.Landroid/net/ip/IIpClient$Stub$Proxy;: Removed from the factory InProcessNetworkStack.apk by R8; the system_server proxy in services.jar is identical.
explained_differences.Landroid/net/ip/IIpClientCallbacks$Defau: Removed from the factory InProcessNetworkStack.apk by R8; IIpClientCallbacks$Stub$Proxy is identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/connectivity/Network: updateDnsEvent/updateDnsEvents: the factory body only forwards to android.net.networkstatuscollect.NetworkStatusCollect.addDnsEventInfo, a ByteDance Slardar telemetry collector (TcpSocketTracker, SlardarServiceProxy binding com.bytedance.os.slardar.ACTION_SLARDAR_SERVICE) that is deliberately not ported; the Source methods exist with the factory signatures and receive the calls (NetworkStackService$NetworkMonitorImpl is identical).

also_identical: android.os.storage.IStorageManager (clearUserKeyAuth appended, same CodeLinaro change as IVold)

donors.CodeLinaro LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900-sm8250.0: IAccountManager, INotificationManager, ITaskStackListener, IBluetoothManager (system/bt 336e28a2 + frameworks/base), IBiometricService, INetworkMonitorCallbacks, IIpClient, IIpClientCallbacks (services/net aidl version 5, packages/modules/NetworkStack 2479fe58), INfcAdapter (packages/apps/Nfc 9d913001), IInstalld (frameworks/native bf08d9a8), IUserManager, IVold (system/vold 020b06ad), IWindow, IConnectionService (+ Telecomm/TeleService), IIccPhoneBook, ISms, ITelephonyRegistry (frameworks/opt/telephony, frameworks/base 4eb3b752); CodeLinaro tables equal the factory tables for these interfaces
donors.android-11.0.0_r48 + factory DEX: IDisplayManager.createVirtualDisplayExt: VirtualDisplayConfig (with the AnnotationValidations checks as static members, as in the factory), DisplayManager/DisplayManagerGlobal clients, BinderService/createVirtualDisplayInternal/VirtualDisplayAdapter/DisplayDevice displayIdToMirror; the Android 10 createVirtualDisplay builds a VirtualDisplayConfig and delegates, and both accept the "android" package name like the factory
donors.factory DEX (PICO, no donor): INetworkMonitor.updateDnsEvent/updateDnsEvents (codes 8/9, oneway), NetworkMonitorManager.updateDnsEvent(s), ConnectivityService DNS event batching (5 s gate, 30 entries), NetworkStackService$NetworkMonitorImpl forwarding

decisions.on_dns_event_evidence: Factory ConnectivityService$5.onDnsEvent equals Source ConnectivityService$4.onDnsEvent after removing register moves (anonymous class numbering differs because the factory has an extra CodeLinaro PhoneStateListener); addDnsEventInfo/clearDnsEventInfo identical.

not_ported.NetworkStatusCollect telemetry: Factory NetworkMonitor.updateDnsEvent(s) only feed android.net.networkstatuscollect.NetworkStatusCollect (TcpSocketTracker, DNS/data-stall collection) which reports to the ByteDance Slardar service (com.bytedance.os.slardar.ACTION_SLARDAR_SERVICE, OsTeaTracker). Telemetry, deliberately not ported; the Source methods receive the calls with the factory signatures.
not_ported.networkstack frozen versions: The PICO methods are inserted in the middle of the frozen version 5 INetworkMonitor, so the Android 10 aidl_interface checkapi between versions fails; networkstack-aidl-interfaces keeps only version 5 (ipmemorystore keeps 1,2,3,5). The factory ships version 5 with the same table.
not_ported.vold wrapped keys: fscrypt_clear_user_key_auth ports the non-wrapped-key path only. The factory vendor fstab uses fileencryption=ice,wrappedkey for /data and /metadata; wrapped-key (ICE) support is missing in the Source vold/fs_mgr as a whole, independent of this table port - a separate vold port is required before the Source image can mount the existing userdata.
not_ported.SystemUI BubbleController: CodeLinaro BubbleController reacts to onSingleTaskDisplayDrawn/Empty using the Android 10 QPR bubbles rewrite (Bubble.getDisplayId, BubbleData.notifyDisplayEmpty); not ported. The factory image has no SystemUI; the SystemUI shared listener dispatch is ported.
not_ported.statsd atoms: Only the NotificationRemoteViews pulled atom (10066) is added to atoms.proto; the other CodeLinaro atoms (VmsClientStats 10065, BackGesture, ExclusionRectStateChanged, VmsClientConnectionStateChanged) belong to other features.
not_ported.PICO capture displays: Factory VirtualDisplayAdapter additionally computes a capture type/token (CaptureDisplayUtils, CaptureSurfaceAgent) and the Smartisan skip-single-layer flag; PICO subsystems without donor.
